name: Zeke
description: Level system! Kill enemies for XP orbs, collect 10 to level up. 5 unique arenas that get harder. Reach Level 5 to win!

name: Papi
description: Press B to drop meat! Enemies love it - they chase the meat, eat it for 1 second, then come back for you. Use it to escape!

name: Zeke
description: Random powers every 10 seconds! Press X to activate: Speed Boost (2x fast), Invisibility (enemies scatter), or Piercing Shots (bullets go through enemies). Multiple enemies eat meat faster!

name: Papi
description: Soup the dog is your sidekick! He guards you by chasing and eating nearby enemies. When he's chilling, he does tricks - spins, jumps, rolls, zoomies, and more!

name: Gabi
description: No more free health between levels! Enemies have a 10% chance to drop a heart pickup when they die. Survive smarter!
